messages:
sam: Quick non-work q — if one mundane item in your life were magically auto-refilled forever, what would you pick? toothpaste? socks? coffee beans? Explain in one line :sparkles:

maria: Coffee beans. I grind at home — nothing ruins a morning like scraping the bottom of the bag at 7am. :coffee:
alex: Socks. I swear the dryer eats them. Auto-socks subscription = peak adulting :joy:
taylor: Printer paper. Not glamorous but saves my soul (and the office's) when a last-minute print is needed.
jordan: Toothpaste. Tiny but devastating when it runs out mid-brush :scream: Also saves the panic-store-run.
noah: Phone charger cables — always fray or vanish. Would nominate braided USB-C forever.
dev-bot: poll created: :coffee: Coffee / :socks: Socks / :paper: Paper / :toothpaste: Toothpaste / :cable: Chargers — vote with reactions
sam: Adding an honorable mention: office snack stash (granola + dark chocolate) — @maria I'm looking at you for granola refills :eyes:
maria: lol noted. I approve of this plan. GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/food-snack-XreQmk7ETCak0
notes: Single-thread Slack conversation; messages in chronological order; includes a tiny bot message creating a lightweight poll.
